case_name: Smt. Anokh W/O Shri Jai Prakash D/O Shri ... vs Jai Prakash S/O Shri Ramniwas

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Anokh W/o Shri Jai Prakash D/o Shri Rameshwarlal, Aged About 42 Years
parties.respondent_defendant: Jai Prakash S/o Shri Ramniwas, Aged About 43 Years

facts_of_case: Respondent has filed the petition under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 against the applicant seeking a decree of divorce. Applicant moved an application under Order 7 Rule 11 of Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 for rejection of the divorce petition.

legal_principles.principle: An application seeking condonation of delay in filing an appeal is liable to be decided by adopting a liberal approach.
legal_principles.held: However, in the present case, we are conscious of the fact that an application seeking condonation of delay in filing an appeal is liable to be decided by adopting a liberal approach.

legal_principles.principle: No cogent explanation has been given for condonation of delay in filing an appeal.
legal_principles.held: A perusal of the application seeking condonation of delay in filing the appeal reveals that no cogent explanation has been given for condonation of delay in filing the appeal.

outcome.final_order: Application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act is dismissed. Consequently, appeal is dismissed being time barred.

use_for_drafting: appealing trial court orders in Jaipur
